arguments.content: Task: Compile SQLite with gcov instrumentation at /app/sqlite and add to PATH
SQLite source location: /app/vendor/sqlite-fossil-release.tar.gz (pre-vendored, do NOT fetch from network)
Build requirements: gcov instrumentation must be enabled during compilation (typically CFLAGS with --coverage or -fprofile-arcs -ftest-coverage)
Target installation directory: /app/sqlite (compiled binaries must be available in PATH)
